note: Documentation-only field reference (G6 §2 pin). NOT loaded at runtime — core/save_codec.gd is the authoritative schema. All files live under user:// and are written atomically (temp file + rename).

fields.save_version: int — current 1; unrecognized version triggers fresh start with notification
fields.floor: int — NEXT uncompleted floor (1..24); the only save point is floor_results entry
fields.score: int — cumulative total at last floor_results entry, including death penalties
fields.potions_remaining: int — 0..3, as the last floor ended
fields.ng_plus: bool — LAR-1 field; always false in this build (DIS-8: NG+ OUT)
fields.timestamp: int — unix seconds at save write

invariants: Written in exactly ONE place: entry into floor_results. No mid-floor save can ever exist.
class_select lock-in begins a new campaign in memory only; the old save survives until the first floor_results entry of the new run atomically replaces it.
Tokens are never persisted: the only save point is floor_results entry where tokens are always 2.

fields.ng_plus_unlocked: bool — always false in this build (DIS-8)
fields.classes_cleared: Array[String] — appended at campaign_results entry only; drives class-select laurels

fields.standard: Dictionary[String -> Array] — per-class local guestbook, max 10 entries each, {initials, score, floor, timestamp}

fields.reduced_motion: bool — G5: dying crumble 1.2s -> 0.2s, no crossfades
fields.rumble_intensity: int 0..100 — LAR-2 event-driven patterns scale by this
fields.auto_fire: bool — hold-to-throw fires at base rate (G5 decision 14)
fields.bindings: Dictionary[String -> Dictionary] — per-action physical key/button overrides for remap_capture
